qualification.details: Qualification: Essential: Master's degree in Engineering / Technology (ME / M.Tech / M.Des) or MS by Research in Engineering / Technology or 5-year integrated Masters with a good academic record; OR Master's degree in Sciences / Arts with a good academic record and of exceptional merit, with a valid GATE score or CSIR UGC NET / NBHM / DAE-JEST or equivalent qualification; OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology with an exceptionally good academic record, with conditions a), b) or c) as printed Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on last date of receiving the application) Age relaxation: All Age relaxation is applicable as per GoI norms | Other conditions: | Initial duration is 6 months, extendable till 24-10-2026. Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of interview for verification.
important_instructions: For clarification on the application process contact the PI by email

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram Notification PDF 2026

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Essential: Master's degree in Engineering / Technology (ME / M.Tech / M.Des) or MS by Research in Engineering / Technology or 5-year integrated Masters with a good academic record; OR Master's degree in Sciences / Arts with a good academic record and of exceptional merit, with a valid GATE score or CSIR UGC NET / NBHM / DAE-JEST or equivalent qualification; OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology with an exceptionally good academic record, with conditions a), b) or c) as printed Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on last date of receiving the application) Age relaxation: All Age relaxation is applicable as per GoI norms Other conditions: Initial duration is 6 months, extendable till 24-10-2026. Candidates must be present physically for the test/interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Desirable: Expertise in Python Coding Knowledge in machine learning and deep learning Development of Mobile and Web application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual post, initially for 06 months May be extended till 24-10-2027 27% HRA paid if no accommodation is provided by the Institute

content_sections.heading: How Will IIITDM Kancheepuram Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Interview Written test followed by interview Topic and syllabus for the written test will be shared later

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printed, filled and signed application form (hard copy) at the time of interview All educational and experience certificates for verification at interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online through the Google form link given in the notice by 01-12-2026. Take a print of the application form, fill it, sign it and submit the hard copy at the time of interview. Be present physically at IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai for the written test and/or interview. Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: For clarification on the application process contact the PI by email
